plugins.name: bms-speckit
plugins.description: Fully autonomous 11-step chain-orchestrated dev pipeline with research, rolling QC, SQL schema validation, real-database integration testing, HOSxP business logic semantic validation, and brand/layout consistency enforcement: brainstorm → research → constitution → specify → plan → tasks → analyze → implement (per-task integration tests + business logic + brand checks) → QC (9 dimensions including navbar/login/layout professional polish) → merge. Never prompts for clarification — resolves all ambiguities with documented defaults. The autonomous goal-completion loop uses Claude Code's built-in /goal (with an opt-in Stop hook for hands-off runs); on other runtimes the 11 steps still run, without the native auto-iterate loop.
